description: Skype 'interrogation': fake obscene-video case, move to Skype, stay available, warrant.

events.text: A case has been registered against your number for sharing obscene videos. We are sending the warrant to your address by evening.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: You need to remain on this video call until the officer verifies your statement. Switching off the camera or telling relatives will make the case worse.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: Pay the bail guarantee into the court account, the details are on your screen, you will get the full amount back.
events.speaker: caller
